        public List<ImageEntry> Images { get; } = [];

        /// <summary>
        /// Gets or sets the raw data. The setter exists so callers can author a
        /// new Panorama resource (e.g. a custom .vsvg_c icon) from a template and
        /// re-serialize it; refresh <see cref="CRC32"/> to match (Serialize writes
        /// the stored checksum verbatim).
        /// </summary>
        public byte[] Data { get; set; } = []; // vpkstuff patch: writable for .vsvg_c authoring
        /// <summary>
        /// Gets or sets the CRC32 checksum. Settable so authoring keeps it in sync
        /// with a replaced <see cref="Data"/> payload.
        /// </summary>
        public uint CRC32 { get; set; } // vpkstuff patch: writable for .vsvg_c authoring
